signal: Cloud PAPER Safety CI push trigger explicitly listed 12 historical branch names; newly created fix/cloud-paper-ci-branch-coverage-20261024 did not match any pattern.
root_cause: Workflow push branch allowlist was maintained by appending exact branch names, coupling every new isolated PAPER fix to a manual YAML edit.
impact: A future isolated PAPER fix branch could lack direct-head Cloud PAPER Safety CI while stacked PR checks target neither main nor feat/cloud-paper-runner. Absence of CI is not PASS.

patch.change: Use bounded quoted fix/cloud-paper-* glob; retain feat/cloud-paper-runner and pull_request/dispatch.
patch.rollback: Governed revert of branch-trigger change if unintended scope or missed routing is observed; no force push.

failed_attempt.direct_cause: Existing regression asserted historical literal branch names instead of matching the new glob; no test bypass was used.

acceptance: Fresh exact-head push-triggered CI with complete mandatory test steps and explicit skips; negative unrelated-branch exclusion; no reduction of PAPER safety flags.
next_session_recurrence_check: On next owned fix/cloud-paper-* branch, confirm push-triggered workflow run head_sha matches new commit and all mandatory steps execute. Reopen if absent or skipped.
